question: Does retaining 96 days in a mixed-resolution 48-position representation offer a useful tradeoff compared with 48 daily positions, under matched model shapes?
scope: Exploratory development after observed ETH pilot; no independent confirmation or score-selected optimal representation
source_and_units: Same private qualified CDD Bitstamp ETH/USD daily OHLC; bounded local non-commercial use
target: Same next daily candle Close and model-independent training/validation keys as parent f100
scaler: Same frozen full-training channel normalization; raw48 is a tail slice of the already normalized 96-day array; no arm-specific refit
invariants: Same parent train/validation targets and keys, even though raw48 could otherwise generate more early windows
Same scaler and full-train RMSSE denominator
Same daily last Close; persistence must be identical
Same 600-step training policy, shuffle seed, batch size, sample exposures and checkpoint rules
raw48 and mixed48 have identical model shapes and same-seed initial parameter bytes

comparisons.mixed48_vs_raw48: Joint representation tradeoff under equal input length/capacity: mixed48 adds 48 calendar days of coarse history and coarsens 16 days that raw48 represents daily. Coverage, resolution, RevIN and moving-average semantics are not individually isolated.
comparisons.mixed48_vs_raw96: Same 96-day wall-clock context but joint changes in resolution, projection capacity, initialization and temporal statistics; not pure preprocessing attribution

resource_basis: Same verified architecture dimensions and explicit bounded count; not allocated from which condition scored better
test_evaluation: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_DRAFT; default proposal is validation-only development
acceptance_margin_status: TBD before a decision-based run: project resource/precision objective required. Cannot choose a noninferiority margin after viewing new scores.
missing_before_release: Formal prospective protocol approval with actual post-engineering HEAD and all code/manifest pins
Independent engineering review of new modules
Predefined cost/precision objective or explicit diagnostic-only interpretation
New runner/preparation/audit supporting raw48 and position-span metadata
failure_policy: New attempts only; preserve artifacts, no deletion-based retry or silent substitution
claim_limit: Raw48 is a capacity control, not proof of incremental information or an independent isolation of coverage and resolution. Seed repeats are not independent markets. Validation-selected checkpoints are not unexposed confirmation.
publication: No public raw/role arrays/per-key predictions/checkpoints; summary review is separate. Existing R1 confirmation remains unchanged.
